flightForm.siteHint: Tell us when you land so we can plan airport pick-ups.
flightForm.title: Your flights
flightForm.intro: Tell us how you’re getting here. Your flights go straight to {couple}, so they can plan airport pick-ups.
flightForm.findIntro: Type the name on your invitation to find your flights form.
flightForm.notFound: We couldn’t find that invitation. Check the code or type your name.
flightForm.needsRide: We’d love a ride from the airport
flightForm.notesPlaceholder: e.g. travelling with a baby seat, arriving by car on the way back
flightForm.saved: Thank you! Your flights were sent to the couple.
flightForm.needDateTime: Please add the date and time of your {flight}.
flightForm.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

flightBoard.formText: Guests fill in their flights on your wedding website and they appear on this board by themselves. You decide who gets an airport shuttle.
flightBoard.formOff: The flight form is switched off. Turn on “Ask guests about travel plans” in RSVP settings to show it on your website.
flightBoard.formOn: Your flight form is live. Share this link with guests:
flightBoard.guestOwned: A guest shared this flight. If they change it on the website, their version replaces yours.
flightBoard.toDecide: {count, plural, one {# guest asked for a ride. Switch “Shuttle” on if you’ll pick them up.} other {# guests asked for a ride. Switch “Shuttle” on for the ones you’ll pick up.}}
flightBoard.shuttleEmpty: Nobody is on a shuttle yet. Switch “Shuttle” on for the arrivals you’ll pick up.

hotelShortlist.title: Hotels you’re comparing
hotelShortlist.intro: Save hotels you like and compare prices side by side. These stay in the app; guests never see them.
hotelShortlist.quickAdd: Add a hotel from a link
hotelShortlist.quickAddHint: Paste a link from Booking.com, Airbnb, Google Maps or the hotel’s own website. We fill in what we can; you can add the price.
hotelShortlist.linkInvalid: That doesn’t look like a web link.
hotelShortlist.fetchFailed: We couldn’t read that page, so we used the link’s name. Check the details.
hotelShortlist.empty: No hotels to compare yet. Paste a link above, or tap the heart on any hotel.
